mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file(file_name, store_name, extension, path, file_size, board_id) VALUES (#{fileName},#{storeName},#{extension},#{path},#{fileSize},#{boardId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name, store_name, extension, path, file_size, board_id FROM file WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = false

SELECT f.id, f.file_name, f.store_name, f.extension, f.path, f.file_size, f.board_id FROM file f INNER JOIN board b ON f.board_id = b.id WHERE f.id = #{fileId} AND f.state = false AND b.state = false AND b.board_type_id = #{boardTypeId}
SELECT id, file_name, store_name, extension, path, file_size, board_id FROM file WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND state = false ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
